title: Convergent Form, Divergent Voice II — Corpus
description: Research corpus of freeflow and values probes with explicit deployment provenance. The 1.2.60 release adds 245 revision-pinned Qwen1.5 14B Chat BF16 Colab/vLLM traces. No new DOI is claimed. Summary: 70,607 valid samples, 616 probe cells, 208 model labels; deployment labels are not unique-weight identities.
